import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# Features and Target
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c != "Id" and c != "Cover_Type"]
target_col = "Cover_Type"

X_train = train_df[feature_cols]
y_train = train_df[target_col]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_ids = test_df["Id"]

# Split Training Data for Validation
val_ratio = 0.8
train_size = int(len(X_train) * val_ratio)

X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=1 - val_ratio, random_state=42
)

# Define Hyperparameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": y_train.nunique(),
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "verbose": -1,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "n_estimators": 200,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 1.0,
    "max_depth": -1,
}

# Train on Training Split
print("Training on training split...")
model_split = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model_split.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Evaluate on Validation Split
y_val_pred = model_split.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Refit on Full Training Data for Submission
print("Retraining on full training data...")
model_final = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model_final.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict on Test Set
y_test_pred = model_final.predict(X_test)

# Create Submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred.astype(int)})
submission.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
